scope: Original Builder configuration, attachments carried into owner-inspected hosted plugin releases, and surviving repository evidence. The public index contains metadata and checksums.
repositoryFileManifest: For each former repository, resolve repositoryEvidence paths below <route>/source/. The files array in <route>/product.json records their exact SHA-256 and Git blob. earlierFoundryEvidence records additional historical authoring files by commit. Catalog, exactSource, archiveMember and differentRepositoryVersion paths start at the FoundRy root. A differentRepositoryVersion has different content from the hosted attachment.
builderEvidence: Editor-observed records describe the captured Builder view, including saved draft views. Hashes cover exact UTF-8 field values with no trimming. Starter digests preserve order. orderedNamesSha256 covers the UTF-8 JSON filename list serialized without whitespace or ASCII escaping. sameFilenamesAsPlugin compares filename multisets. The Builder exposed labels rather than download digests, so matching names do not independently authenticate legacy upload bytes. Verbatim repository comparisons normalize line endings. The additional starter comparison trims outer quotes and whitespace on the editor strings.
pluginEvidence: All 53 hosted knowledge indexes were read. All 228 filenames and paths resolved to an attachment with recovered bytes. pluginInstructionFile.bodySha256 covers UTF-8 text after the frontmatter and its following blank line. pluginDefaultPromptSha256 lists UTF-8 hashes in the order exposed by the hosted manifest. The Builder can contain additional starters.
contentReview: publicReuse is the source review before packaging. Exact Git recovery and public redistribution are independent. A private-original entry is available only as a verification digest here. For requires-derivative, package a reviewed version that removes the listed exposure or excludes unverified artwork.

roles.reported-instructions: Historical Pulsebook section marked as an exact copy by its author.
roles.reported-starters: Historical Pulsebook section describing starters on that date.
roles.authored-instructions: Product-specific authored system instructions in the preserved repository.
roles.sample-starters: Examples of prompts for the product.
roles.empty-prompt-placeholder: A file explicitly awaiting prompt extraction.
roles.parent-pulsebook: A parent capability document carried in a child repository.
roles.repository-reference: Product reference, example, or test fixture.
roles.archived-knowledge-bundle: An original archive containing product references.
roles.repository-knowledge-document: Preserved source-format knowledge document. The native upload can differ.
